beats.what: Safdarjung logged 40 mm of rain by 5:30 am Monday. IMD warned of lightning and gusty winds around 60 km/h.
beats.why: The red alert covered all 11 districts, with heavy spells of over 15 mm an hour possible.

cards.body: CPCB's 'Satisfactory' band, as the rain washed pollutants out of the air.
cards.caption: Delhi AQI, 7 am Monday

cards.body: Waterlogging hit areas near Jhandewalan temple in Karol Bagh and low-lying stretches. Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad also got heavy rain. IMD advised avoiding unnecessary travel.
Highs dipped only 1–2°C. Maximums are still around 30–32°C, so expect muggy weather between spells.

cards.q: How did the rain hit your Monday?
What does an IMD 'red alert' mean?
cards.why: Red is IMD's highest warning level, telling people to take action against severe weather.
